message.content: {"note_claim": "The footage is from a Nov 2025 anhydrous ammonia leak from a tanker truck at a Holiday Inn Express in Weatherford, OK, with many hospitalized and hundreds evacuated, not a catastrophic storage tank rupture.", "label": "SUPPORTS", "quote": "On November 12, 2025, about 9:16 p.m. local time, an Airgas Specialty Products cargo tank transporting Anhydrous Ammonia experienced a leak while parked in Weatherford, Oklahoma.", "reason": "The page confirms the Nov 2025 tanker leak at a Holiday Inn Express in Weatherford, with 74 injured and 500 to 1,000 evacuated, matching the note's core claims, though it does not address the video itself or the 60-mile claim."}

parsed.note_claim: The footage is from a Nov 2025 anhydrous ammonia leak from a tanker truck at a Holiday Inn Express in Weatherford, OK, with many hospitalized and hundreds evacuated, not a catastrophic storage tank rupture.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: On November 12, 2025, about 9:16 p.m. local time, an Airgas Specialty Products cargo tank transporting Anhydrous Ammonia experienced a leak while parked in Weatherford, Oklahoma.
parsed.reason: The page confirms the Nov 2025 tanker leak at a Holiday Inn Express in Weatherford, with 74 injured and 500 to 1,000 evacuated, matching the note's core claims, though it does not address the video itself or the 60-mile claim.
